title: Colorful Produce Parade
hook: Seed to basket, page by page!
Produce words step on the stage!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: vibrant 3D colorful-produce storybook, rainbow baskets, rounded fruit and vegetables, uncluttered parade layout

creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line memory anchor whose orchestration changes on repeat
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: Round 1 uses shape, skin, leaf, root, color or market/garden clues without diet lectures or repetitive 'healthy food' claims.
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: Round 2 uses object-conditioned recall: roots and tubers trace underground shapes; leafy produce fans leaf fingers; citrus opens segments; grapes cluster; melons show rind and roundness; peppers/pods show hollow or ridged shapes; stone fruits show a pit; berries show surface seeds or clustered drupelets; onions show layers; long squash/beans/pods trace length. Avoid repeating the same basket gesture for every target.
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a page-turn shaker sweep followed by one bright marimba harvest note.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a page-turn shaker sweep followed by one bright marimba harvest note
